title: Printer Not Responding — Network Printer Issues
error_codes: Error: The print spooler service is not running
Error: Windows cannot connect to the printer
Error 0x0000011b: Windows cannot connect to the printer
diagnostic_questions: Which printer are you trying to use? (Floor/location)
Were you able to print to this printer before?
Are other people on your floor also having issues?
Is the printer showing any error lights or messages on its display?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Verify the print server is operational

resolution_steps.action: First, let's clear any stuck print jobs. Open Settings → Devices → Printers & Scanners. Find your printer, click 'Open queue', and cancel all pending jobs.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Were you able to clear the print queue?

resolution_steps.action: Restart the Print Spooler service. Open Command Prompt as Administrator and run: net stop spooler && net start spooler
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did the Print Spooler restart successfully?

resolution_steps.action: Try printing a test page. Go to Settings → Devices → Printers & Scanners → select your printer → Manage → Print a test page.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did the test page print successfully?

resolution_steps.action: If the test page didn't print, remove and re-add the printer. Go to Settings → Devices → Printers & Scanners → select the printer → Remove device. Then click 'Add a printer or scanner' and wait for it to discover the network printer.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Was the printer re-added successfully and can you now print?

escalation_criteria: If printer remains unresponsive after reinstalling, or if print server is confirmed down
